يأتلف (form VIII)
# يَأْتَلِفُ (yaʔtalifu) /jaʔ.ta.li.fu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِئْتَلَفَ (iʔtalafa)
# يَأْتَلِفَ (yaʔtalifa) /jaʔ.ta.li.fa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِئْتَلَفَ (iʔtalafa)
# يَأْتَلِفْ (yaʔtalif) /jaʔ.ta.lif/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِئْتَلَفَ (iʔtalafa)
